_comment: Hand-written incident entries and corrections. An entry here always wins over the automatic tracker. To correct an automatic entry, copy its id from data/incidents.json and add an entry with the same id. status may be confirmed, corroborated, reported, claimed or disputed. Dates are YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z.

incidents.title: Marks & Spencer cyberattack halts online orders for weeks
incidents.basis: Acknowledged by the organisation or an authority
incidents.summary: The UK retailer told the London Stock Exchange in April 2025 that it was managing a cyber incident. It paused online orders and later told customers that some personal data had been taken.

sources.name: The Record
sources.title: British retailer M&S confirms being hit by 'cyber incident' amid store delays

history.note: Company statement to the London Stock Exchange

incidents.title: Change Healthcare ransomware attack disrupts US health payments
incidents.basis: Acknowledged by the organisation or an authority
incidents.summary: UnitedHealth Group identified intruders in Change Healthcare systems on 21 February 2024. Pharmacy and claims services were disrupted across the US, and the company later estimated about 190 million people were affected.

sources.name: UnitedHealth Group
sources.title: Annual report (Form 10-K) for 2024, section on the Change Healthcare cyberattack

history.note: Disclosed in a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission

incidents.title: Colonial Pipeline shuts down fuel pipeline after ransomware attack
incidents.basis: Acknowledged by the organisation or an authority
incidents.summary: The operator of the largest fuel pipeline on the US East Coast halted operations in May 2021 after ransomware hit its IT systems, causing fuel shortages for several days.

sources.name: FBI
sources.title: FBI statement on compromise of Colonial Pipeline networks
